user.title: Tisséo stop
user.description: Search a stop by name (e.g. Capitole, Jeanne d'Arc) or enter a GTFS stop id (stop_area:SA_1715 / stop_point:SP_1912). The first setup downloads and indexes the Tisséo GTFS (≈14 MB, up to a minute).

stop.title: Choose the stop
stop.description: A stop area covers every platform/direction; a platform is a single stop point (usually one direction).

settings.title: Departures at {stop}
settings.description: Leave the line list empty to include every line serving the stop.

data.realtime: Use live GTFS-RT predictions when published (buses, tram)

error.no_stop: No stop matches this name or ID.
